dedupe_keys.name: fepc infobase data book of japan s electric power industry demand facilities outages nuclear and more

description: FEPC INFOBASE is the annual data book of the Federation of Electric Power Companies of Japan (FEPC), which gathers the main facts about Japan's electric power industry under ten themes. The 2025 edition covers, among others, supply and demand (peak demand and daily energy, their trends since the 1950s, hourly demand on peak days, monthly peaks, supply-demand balance, load factor and future scenarios), power facilities (generating capacity of the ten electric power companies, generation and capacity mix trends, undergrounding of transmission and distribution lines, outage frequency and duration per customer, and electrical accidents by cause), and nuclear power (plant status, capacity and operating factors, safety standards, disaster preparedness and the fuel cycle). Coverage is Japan, mostly the ten major utilities combined; resolution is national annual aggregates, with some monthly and hourly profiles. Format and access: a full PDF and one PDF per theme, with background data (B.D.) tables for many charts. Licence: FEPC invites use of the data book, for example in outreach material; no formal licence was read. Free. Caveats: figures are compiled for public relations and in Japanese, some series cover only the ten former regional monopolies, and the site resets connections intermittently. Simulation uses: demand profiles, capacity mix and reliability statistics for power system planning and resilience benchmarking. Related records: complements METI Electric Power Survey Statistics and the Electrical Japan power plant database.
